text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fukuryu Stakes. A daring 
challenge on dirt, intentionally bypassing 
the Satsuki Sho of the Classic Triple 
Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stepping into the paddock, Copano Rickey 
notices that the venue's qi—the crowd's 
enthusiasm—is faint. That's just how 
little attention dirt racing receives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Should she really not switch to the turf 
"Japanese Derby"? Knowing the answer would 
come once she ran, she pumped herself up 
with determination.
